run_parallel_entropy_preprocessing: run parallel SLURM jobs to preprocess entropy data from JSONL shard files into Arrow format
submit_preprocess_entropies_job: submit a PreprocessEntropiesJob to a SLURM executor for processing a single shard file
check_entropy_output_files: check which shard files have corresponding Arrow complete output files in the output directory
chunk_items_for_batching: chunk a list of items into batches of a specified size for parallel processing
review_preprocess_entropies_job_class: review the PreprocessEntropiesJob class that wraps subprocess calls to the preprocess_entropies module
